source.method: manual copy from the Hardy team results view (athletic.net)
source.note: Meet listed as 'Partial Results' on athletic.net. Distance not stated in the paste; set to 4000m matching the Fort Dupont Park course (corrected 2026-07-27 from an initial 4100m guess - Dario confirmed non-Colmar Manor/Kenilworth courses run closer to 4000m). PB badges dropped from the time field; times as printed had no hundredths, padded to .00 to match the wall's Performance column format (same convention already used for Asia Amis's 2011 row). Alexis Coates's 20:39.00 is faster than any existing girls individual entry outside the top 19 and beats the sub-21:00 cutoff, so it's a new addition to xc_record_wall.html's girls individual table (inserted between Rohini Kieffer and Josephine Caplan). Asia Amis's 20:08 here is slower than her already-recorded 2011 best (19:16.00) so it doesn't change her row. No boys time is close to the sub-19:00 cutoff (Aaron Coates's 19:21 misses it by 21 seconds).
